faqs.question: Does it help in Muscle Gain same as Whey Protein?
faqs.answer: Man Matters Plant Protein is a complete protein that helps you gain muscle effectively, just as well as Whey Protein.

faqs.question: Can this be used as meal replacement to reduce weight?
faqs.answer: Yes, this can be used as a meal replacement and helps you stay in a caloric deficit, leading to weight loss

faqs.question: I don't work out. Can I still consume Vegain Plant Protein Powder?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can. This protein powder helps fuel daily protein needs, which is necessary for every individual irrespective of their lifestyle and activity levels.

faqs.question: Can this be used on non training days?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Protein Powder can be used for non training days to meet your daily protein requirements. We recommend taking 1-2 scoops every day to fulfill your nutrient needs.
